title: ÆON capability profile
description: The capability profile an ÆON runtime establishes before offering or relying on any capability-dependent behaviour (protocol/capabilities.md). A flag is true only after the capability has been verified in the current session; unverified capabilities stay false and degrade gracefully.

capabilities.description: Verified capability flags. The ten canonical keys are always present; runtimes may add further boolean flags for capabilities the protocol does not name.

web_research.description: The agent can retrieve and read live web content in this session.

persistent_memory.description: The agent can store information and recall it in a later session.

scheduled_tasks.description: The agent can schedule future or recurring runs, such as daily session delivery.

proactive_notifications.description: The agent can contact the user without being prompted.

audio_generation.description: The agent can produce audio output, such as a generated podcast episode.

text_to_speech.description: The agent can synthesise speech from text.

file_generation.description: The agent can create files the user can keep.

presentation_generation.description: The agent can generate slide presentations.

code_execution.description: The agent can execute code in this session.

additionalProperties.description: Extension capability flag with the same verified-boolean semantics as the canonical keys.
